title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-23-draft
content:
Weekly sync: serving-runtime / infra / console — agenda + prep notes (draft)

Meeting details:
- Date: Mon 2026-03-23
- Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT (45m)
- Location: Zoom / #eng-serving-runtime channel
- Facilitator: Jordan Kim
- Note taker: Maya Patel (rotating)
- Attendees (recurring): Jordan, Maya, Liam, Sofie, Diego, Ravi (infra), Priya (console), optional: Ops on-call

Goals for this week:
1) Quick sync on rollout status for seq-len-optimized kernels (canary)
2) Decide canary gating criteria for latency regressions and memory amplification
3) Infra follow-ups: autoscaler tuning after spike last Wed
4) Console work: rollout progress on per-route cost breakdown UI and bug triage
5) Track action items and owners; surface any blockers needing escalation

Agenda (high level, timeboxed):
- 10:00-10:05 (5m) — Quick wins / shoutouts / blockers (round robin)
  - FYI: Diego resolved token cache eviction bug in dev; still failing rare cases on long prompt replay (see PR 987)
- 10:05-10:20 (15m) — Canary rollout status: seq-len kernels
  - Current canary: 10% of traffic on dedicated fleet (us-west). Metrics: p50/p95 latency, memory, OOMs
  - Jordan quick summary of telemetry: p50 -1.2ms, p95 +6ms on long seqs, 2 OOMs last 48h (investigating)
  - Decision needed: widen canary to 25% if no further OOMs in 24h OR revert and hotfix?
  - Prep notes: logs attached: INF-logs-2026-03-21 (Confluence link)
- 10:20-10:30 (10m) — Autoscaler tuning follow-up (Ravi/Liam)
  - Root cause: spike in chat-burst workload exposed under-provisioned scale-out window
  - Proposed quick change: reduce scale-up cooldown from 90s -> 45s for burst-priority pools; test on staging this week
  - Risk: potential chattier autoscaler ops; need to watch cost bump (estimate +2.3% for peak)
- 10:30-10:38 (8m) — Console: per-route cost UI + bug triage (Priya/Sofie)
  - Blocker: route-level aggregation missing tokens for streaming responses (see ticket ENG-4123)
  - Patch ETA: EOD Wed; need QA on staging after DB schema migrate
- 10:38-10:43 (5m) — Open floor: other items / quick asks
- 10:43-10:45 (2m) — Review action items & owners; confirm follow-ups

Prep notes / data to review before meeting:
- Canary dashboard (link): look at p95 over last 72h and per-model breakdown
- PR 987: Diego's token cache eviction fix — read the test notes and perf bench (link above)
- Autoscaler incident notes: Linear INFRA-221 (linked)
- Console patch: frontend build on staging failing intermittently — bring logs if you hit it

Decisions / acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Canary widen to 25% if: no new OOMs in next 24h AND p95 regressions <= 5% vs baseline AND memory growth rate stable
- Autoscaler cooldown change approved for burst pools in staging only; revert if cost delta > 5% or error rate increases > 0.5%

Action items (live tracker) — short, owner, due date, status notes (scratchpad style):
- AI-01: Investigate OOM root cause on canary (collect heap dump + timeline) — owner: Diego — due: 2026-03-23 — status: in_progress; had two repros, need one full heap dump from next repro
- AI-02: Run extended perf benchmark on seq-len kernels (10k requests, mixed seqs) — owner: Jordan — due: 2026-03-24 — status: scheduled; infra staging reserved 03/24 02:00-04:00 PT
- AI-03: Autoscaler cooldown experiment in staging (45s) + smoke test — owner: Liam — due: 2026-03-25 — status: blocked (need staging quota increase, filed ENG-4251)
- AI-04: Fix route-level token aggregation bug in console (ENG-4123) — owner: Priya — due: 2026-03-25 — status: in_progress; PR open, needs QA
- AI-05: Add alert for memory amplification > X% over 1h for canary fleet — owner: Sofie — due: 2026-03-24 — status: todo; draft alert rules in Grafana
- AI-06: Prepare short rollback playbook for seq-len kernels (steps + comms channel) — owner: Maya — due: 2026-03-23 (EOD) — status: in_progress

Parking lot / non-urgent items:
- Follow-up on KV cache eviction TTL heuristics (research notes next week)
- Evaluate quantization profile changes for T4 vs A100 (cost sim)

Notes to self (Jordan):
- Remind PMs to update customer-facing notes if we widen canary — particularly customers with low-latency SLOs
- Check with legal about telemetry retention for heap dumps before collecting prod artifacts
- If OOMs persist, escalate to SRE on-call for live-debug session (schedule ASAP)

Post-meeting follow-up template (use for email/Slack):
- Subject: [SYNC follow-up] Serving runtime weekly — 2026-03-23
- TL;DR decisions: {list}
- Action items: {list with owners + dates}
- Links / artifacts: {dashboard, PRs, tickets}
- Next meeting: 2026-03-30 (confirm availability)

Rough outcomes to aim for today:
- Clear decision on canary gating OR explicit rollback plan
- Autoscaler experiment unblocked in staging
- Console token aggregation fix merged to staging + QA scheduled

Unresolved questions to surface in meeting:
- Is current canary telemetry sufficient to detect edge-case memory leaks? (Sofie)
- Do we want to add a temporary rate-limit on long-seq requests to reduce blast radius? Pros/cons

End of draft.
